description: Mol Biology Tools is a free browser-based suite for sequence analysis, primer design, plasmid editing and wet-lab calculations. Its sequence tools cover PCR and Sanger primer design, primer walking plans, binding checks, screening primers against a selected DNA reference, restriction site analysis, reverse complements, ORF finding, DNA-to-protein translation and codon optimisation. Assembly PCR, Gibson assembly and site-directed mutagenesis designers support cloning design, while Plasmid Editor lets users inspect and edit supplied DNA and annotations. Calculators cover ligation, molarity, dilution, buffer preparation and multi-solute solution recipes. The tools process input sequences locally in the browser, without requiring an account or uploading those sequences to a server.

function.note: Primer Scan screens supplied primer pairs against a selected assembled DNA reference and reports candidate matches and products. Primer Binding Checker maps supplied primers on a particular template. Predictions depend on the supplied reference and settings; they do not establish PCR success.
Codon Optimizer edits a coding DNA sequence using selected codon preferences while preserving the translated protein. It does not predict a genetic code or guarantee expression performance.

PCR primer design includes the PCR, Assembly PCR, Gibson Assembly and Site-Directed Mutagenesis designers. Supplied templates or fragment sequences determine the proposed primers and predicted construct; designs require template-specific review and experimental validation.
Plasmid Editor supports manual editing of supplied DNA and annotations, linked map/sequence views and sequence or map export. It does not automatically annotate missing features.

link.note: A free online tool for preparing common lab buffer recipes by target pH, buffer strength, salt form, and final volume.
Codon Optimizer is a free online optimization tool for preserving the translated protein sequence while checking GC content, codon changes, and downstream primer design.
DNA ligation calculator for cloning setup, vector mass, insert length, insert-to-vector molar ratio, and insert mass calculation.
Design PCR primers and terminal overlaps for NEBuilder HiFi, GeneArt, In-Fusion or overlap PCR from ordered DNA fragments. Review the predicted construct and export primers and sequence results.

Design primers for single or multiple nucleotide substitutions using supported overlap PCR, circular assembly or inverse PCR workflows. Review edited bases and the predicted final sequence; insertions and deletions are outside the advertised scope.
Design primers with terminal overlaps for Gibson assembly from a vector and ordered DNA fragments. Review overlaps, junctions and the predicted construct, then export primers and sequence results.
Free online ORF finder and DNA to protein translator for open reading frames, coding-region checks, amino acid translation, and expression planning.
Free online Sanger sequencing primer design tool for primer walking, target coverage, high-quality read planning, and binding validation.
Free online dilution calculator for C1V1 logic, prepared stock solutions, and antibody 1:N ratios; molecular weight is required only for cross-unit conversion.
Generate a reverse complement, complement, reversed sequence, or cleaned DNA from plain-text, FASTA, or GenBank input, with full IUPAC ambiguity-code support

Inspect and edit supplied DNA and annotations with linked plasmid-map, sequence and feature views. Save local projects or export sequence files and maps; missing features are not annotated automatically.
Landing page with all tools listed.
PCR primer design tool for raw DNA, FASTA, or GenBank templates, with primer length or target Tm modes and optional restriction-enzyme overhang planning.
Primer binding checker for linear or circular DNA templates, including binding positions, amplicon size, strand direction, and product checks.
Restriction enzyme site analyzer for linear or circular DNA, FASTA, or GenBank input, with enzyme cut-site detection and sequence-to-primer workflow links.

Screen named primer pairs against a selected genome or custom DNA reference. Review predicted binding sites, candidate products and available gene context within the selected reference and settings; this is not a database-wide Primer-BLAST search.
Searchable FAQ covering primer design, Sanger sequencing, restriction sites, sequence checks, molarity, dilution, ligation, and connected tool workflows.
This free online molarity calculator handles single-solute mass, molarity, final-volume and g/L calculations, liquid acid stocks, and protein molarity conversions using molecular weight in kDa
